scenes.question: What is running low at Greenhills?
scenes.answer: Reading yesterday's plan, **only three Greenhills lines are genuinely running low**: Aji Champoy Honey Bayberry down to 1 unit (about a fifth of a day's cover), Cow Label Beef Jerky at 45 units (4.5 days) and Aji Kiamoy Strips at 69 units (5.7 days) — all three A-class movers. Fix the negative stock records at Greenhills before shipping anything off this plan; three quarters of the units requested come from them.

items.message: 99 of the 456 lines in this plan are for products whose recorded stock is NEGATIVE, the worst -15,079. The quantity to ship is worked out as the target level minus what is on hand, so a negative reading adds its own size to the order: those lines account for 4,764 of the 6,344 units requested, 75% of the plan. The biggest lines here are the ones with the most broken stock records.
items.guidance: on_hand is on every row. Do not present a requested quantity from a negative-on-hand line as a real need without saying so.

items.message: The allocated quantity defaults to the requested one, so the two matching does not mean a shipment was confirmed or sent. What actually moved is recorded separately, in the stock transfers.
